2.source: relic set 318 (奇想蕉乐园 / Banana Paradise of the Envious), 2-piece: "Increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by #1[i]%. When the wearer has a summon on the field, increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by an extra #2[i]%." param = [0.16, 0.32]
2.note: Only the conditional sentence; the unconditional "CRIT DMG +16%" is the effect's `properties` stat (CriticalDamageBase 0.16). ⚠ The extra is 0.32, not 0.16 -- param #2, and the two happen to differ (the registered reason said 16% until this file was written; the parameters are the source, not my reading of the sentence). ⚠ WHY NOT `permanent`: 「当存在装备者召唤的目标时」 is a WHILE condition, and a permanent buff would stay up after the summon died -- a wrong state that nothing reports. It is therefore re-evaluated at each of the wearer's own turn starts and lasts one turn, which is exactly when CRIT DMG matters (the wearer's own attacks): the buff lapses at the next turn boundary if the summon is gone. ⚠ The approximation that remains: a summon that dies mid-turn keeps the buff until that turn ends. `actor == self` is 「装备者」 -- the condition is about the wearer's own summon, not a teammate's.
